objective: Extend the todo record with the optional webhook_url field (C2 additive) and make POST /todos accept webhook_url at creation so the store round-trips it; no other record key, endpoint, or the C1 GET /todos response key set changes

concepts: in-memory store as single source of truth (DA-1: TodoAPI is the only writer)
frozen C1 response key set — list_todos output must not gain keys in this stage
C2 additive rule: optional fields may be added; existing keys and creation order are untouched

inputs: inlined frozen contracts C1/C2 (below) — do not read stage-contract.json

frozen_contracts.spec: GET /todos response: {todos: [{id: string, title: string, done: boolean, tag?: string}]} — exactly these keys per todo, in creation order; 400 {error} on malformed filter params

todo record shape in store: {id: 't<n>', title: string, done: boolean, tag?: string, webhook_url?: string}; creation order preserved. Stage-2 additive: webhook_url (optional string) added per C2's unfreeze rule (additive-only; stage 2 proposes it in writing in this contract). last_notified_at is intentionally NOT added — it ships only if/when C1 is revised (see Q1).

non_goals: any change to list_todos / the GET /todos response shape (C1 frozen)
last_notified_at or any other new response/record field beyond webhook_url (Q1, deferred)
implementation_constraints: stdlib only; no new third-party imports
webhook_url is optional: absent (not null) when unregistered
list_todos output keys unchanged (C1 canary: tests/test_api.py::test_create_and_list_shape stays green)
store creation order preserved; TodoStore remains the single source of truth (DA-1)

deliverables.what: store records carry optional webhook_url; add/get/all unchanged in behavior for existing keys
create_todo accepts webhook_url from the request body and passes it to the store
unit tests: store round-trip with/without URL, creation path, C1 key-set canary

acceptance_tests.description: create todo with webhook_url='https://hooks.example/cb'; the store record contains the URL and all() round-trips it
acceptance_tests.evidence: test tests/test_registration.py::test_store_roundtrip_with_url asserts the stored record contains the URL

acceptance_tests.description: create todo without webhook_url; the record has no webhook_url key (absent, not null) and existing keys are unchanged
acceptance_tests.evidence: test tests/test_registration.py::test_store_roundtrip_without_url asserts the key is absent (not null)

acceptance_tests.description: after the change, GET /todos per-todo keys are exactly {id, title, done}(+tag) — the frozen suite test asserts the key set
acceptance_tests.evidence: frozen test tests/test_api.py::test_create_and_list_shape (unmodified) asserts the exact key set

failure_cases.scenario: create_todo called with a non-string webhook_url
failure_cases.expected_behavior: reject with 400 {error} — no record is created and no default is written

handoff.notes: checkpoint must record: webhook_url key is absent-not-null, list_todos output verified unchanged against C1, frozen suite green
